# semaphore_ex_project_integration_matcher (Resource)

Manage or read a condition that an incoming integration request must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "semaphore_ex_project_integration_matcher" "branch" {
  project_id     = semaphore_ex_project.example.id
  integration_id = semaphore_ex_project_integration.example.id
  name           = "Main branch only"
  match_type     = "body"
  body_data_type = "json"
  key            = "ref"
  method         = "equals"
  value          = "refs/heads/main"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (Number) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> Integration containing the matcher. Value must be at least 1.
- `key` (String) Header name or JSON field path to match. String length must be at least 1.
- `match_type` (String) Request component to inspect: header or body. String length must be at least 1.Value must be one of : `header`, `body`.
- `name` (String) Matcher name. String length must be at least 1.
- `project_id` (Number) <i style="color:red;font-weight: bold">(ForceNew)</i> Project containing the integration. Value must be at least 1.
- `value` (String) Expected value. String length must be at least 1.

### Optional

- `body_data_type` (String) Body interpretation for body matchers. Value defaults to `json`. String length must be at least 1.Value must be one of : `json`, `string`.
- `method` (String) Comparison operator. Value defaults to `equals`. String length must be at least 1.Value must be one of : `equals`, `unequals`, `contains`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Matcher ID assigned by Semaphore EX.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import semaphore_ex_project_integration_matcher.branch project/1/integration/2/matcher/3
```
